threat_event: Ransomware operator uses a stolen cloud administrator credential to encrypt ACMP databases and delete reachable snapshots
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared-service administrators span divisions; directory trust to the acquired firm; just-in-time elevation can still be abused with a stolen session
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 CP-9; IR-6); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 1.8); Fla. Stat. 282.3185
treatment_plan: Session binding for PAM; bulk-read and snapshot-deletion alerts; full-scale restore exercise

threat_event: Theft of FTI and CJI from the ACMP followed by extortion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No alert on bulk reads by service accounts in the CJI cluster
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 IR-6); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 1.8.2); Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)
treatment_plan: Bulk-read alerts; service accounts in identity governance (POAM-005, POAM-007)

threat_event: A full ACMP restore after ransomware exceeds the 8-hour contract RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 430 tenants restored sequentially; never rehearsed at scale
regulatory_driver: Contract (8-hour RTO; SP 800-53 Moderate); N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 CP-10)
treatment_plan: Parallel restore automation; full-scale exercise (POAM-011)

threat_event: A CSA audit or IRS review finds corporate shared-service staff with CJI or FTI access who are not screened
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Corporate staff not in the GovTech screening register
affected_asset_or_process: ACMP CJI cluster and FTI tenants
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 PS-3; Appendix H); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 2.C.3; Exhibit 7 I(2))
existing_controls: GovTech register for its own staff
treatment_plan: Suspend unscreened access by 2026-10-31; group register (POAM-001)

threat_event: Subcontractor staff reach agency data without Security Addendum certifications or IRS-approved subcontract terms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flowdown not checked for 23 of about 180 subcontractor staff
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 SA-9); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 Exhibit 7 I(8)-(9))
treatment_plan: Suspend access; procurement flowdown checklist (POAM-012)

threat_event: GovTech misses an agency notice clock in a cross-division incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contacts and clocks for about 1,150 contracts kept by account teams; not in the group matrix
treatment_plan: Load all agency contacts into the group matrix; quarterly checks (POAM-003)

threat_event: IRS review finds identity and cloud logs for FTI systems kept 2 years
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Common control retention set at 2 years
treatment_plan: 7-year retention (POAM-002)

threat_event: AI eligibility recommendations lead caseworkers to wrong denials or delays for benefit applicants
threat_source: AI model error and automation bias
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High acceptance of recommendations; no review-first design; bias testing incomplete
treatment_plan: Review-first design; deterministic eligibility rules; monthly QC sampling (P10; POAM-016)

threat_event: The AI assistant performs worse for applicants who submit non-English documents or include older household members
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot results show higher error rates for those groups; sample too small
treatment_plan: Stratified bias test of 2,400 cases before any expansion (P10)

threat_event: An employee uses MVSP or ACMP access to look up a person's records for a non-permitted purpose
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Support roles can search across tenants for troubleshooting
existing_controls: Audit logs; weekly MVSP lookup review
treatment_plan: Tenant-scoped support roles; insider analytics

threat_event: A compromised build inserts malicious code into the ACMP
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared CI/CD platform
treatment_plan: Build provenance and isolated runners (group plan)

threat_event: A tenant isolation defect exposes one agency's data to another agency
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared cluster with tenant filters in code
existing_controls: Isolation tests every release; FTI and CJI tenants separated
treatment_plan: Row-level security in the shared cluster

threat_event: FTI reaches the IEP, where it is prohibited, through uploaded documents or caseworker notes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: IRS income match results exist in agency systems that caseworkers also use
existing_controls: Interface sends no income match fields; caseworker training
treatment_plan: Pattern detection for IRS match fields in notes and uploads

threat_event: Agency users attach screenshots with FTI or CJI to support tickets in the IT service management system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Ticket attachments are not filtered; the system is not named in revenue agencies' IRS notifications
regulatory_driver: N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 Exhibit 7 I(8)); N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 SA-9)
treatment_plan: Block regulated attachments from FTI and CJI tenants; in-platform secure support (POAM-015)

threat_event: FTI backups in provider B are not covered by 2 revenue agencies' IRS 45-day notifications
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 notifications predate the 2025 move of backups to provider B
existing_controls: Provider B is FedRAMP authorized and U.S.-only
treatment_plan: Ask both agencies to file updated notifications; hold further changes until filed (POAM-027)

threat_event: Stale agency interface credentials are stolen and used to pull data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 18 interface credentials older than 1 year
existing_controls: Secrets management; IP allow-lists with agencies
treatment_plan: Rotate with each agency; automate rotation (POAM-006)

threat_event: An emergency change made without retrospective approval weakens a control or causes an outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 7 of 40 sampled emergency changes lacked approval
treatment_plan: Retrospective approval workflow (POAM-014)

threat_event: An attacker exploits a container vulnerability left past the remediation window
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 11 high findings past 30 days in 2026 Q2
treatment_plan: Image age gate in the pipeline (POAM-013)

threat_event: A breach of Medicaid PHI on the IEP is not reported to the Medicaid agency within its business associate agreement terms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: IEP incident steps do not name the BAA clocks; corporate services handle the PHI without a written subcontractor arrangement
treatment_plan: Add BAA clocks to the matrix; intercompany subcontractor terms for corporate services (POAM-026)

threat_event: A bulk requester of motor vehicle records uses them for a purpose DPPA does not permit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Permitted-use certifications re-verified only at onboarding for 2 of 3 states
treatment_plan: Annual re-verification and sampling of bulk requesters (POAM-017)

threat_event: An IEP outage pushes SNAP applications past their processing deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single production region
treatment_plan: Second-region test for the IEP

threat_event: A CSA audit results in loss of CJI access for the group in a state
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Findings from two 2025 audits closed; gaps 1 and 10 open
treatment_plan: Close GT-004 and GT-005 before the next audits

threat_event: GovTech staff working in agency-hosted systems bring malware into agency networks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 3,100 staff hold agency-issued accounts used from group laptops
treatment_plan: Agency-issued virtual desktops for high-risk engagements

threat_event: Agency data is kept after a contract ends
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contract-end deletion certified since 2025; older contracts not reviewed
treatment_plan: Review contracts ended before 2025 at the next audit

threat_event: The managed model service retains or uses applicant data beyond the contract terms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Terms confirmed 2026-07; monitoring not automated
existing_controls: No-training and retention terms in writing
treatment_plan: Annual attestation; data minimization in prompts

threat_event: Takeover of a local government user account in the ACMP
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Local accounts with MFA since 2026-03
treatment_plan: None

threat_event: Denial-of-service attack on agency portals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public sign-in pages
treatment_plan: None

threat_event: Provider A regional outage stops the ACMP
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CJI cluster has no tested second region
existing_controls: Multi-zone; shared cluster tested in a second region
treatment_plan: Second-region test for the CJI cluster

threat_event: Production agency data is copied into non-production
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Technical block since 2025
existing_controls: Block on production copies; synthetic data
treatment_plan: None

threat_event: Loss of screened specialists delays CJI and FTI support
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Screening per state takes weeks
treatment_plan: Shared screened pool (GR-20)
